title: AgenticEvolve: Evolutionary Program Search with Persistent Language Model Agents that Design and Run Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.31326v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evolutionary program search with large language models keeps the structure of an evolutionary algorithm and uses the model as its variation operator. Typically, the model generates each candidate program in a single request from parent programs and their scores. We present AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which each island is run by a persistent large language model agent. Between evaluations, the agent designs and runs experiments on the candidate program. To measure the contribution of experimentation, we compare AgenticEvolve with No-analysis, an otherwise identical configuration with experiments disabled. On two heuristic design tasks with three large language models, AgenticEvolve produces better programs than No-analysis and OpenEvolve on both hidden and unseen instances. translated_title: AgenticEvolve：基于持久化语言模型智能体设计并运行实验的进化程序搜索
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型的进化程序搜索保留了进化算法的结构，并将模型用作其变异算子。通常情况下，模型根据父代程序及其评分，通过单次请求生成每个候选程序。我们提出了AgenticEvolve，这是一个进化程序搜索框架，其中每个岛屿由一个持久化的大语言模型智能体运行。在两次评估之间，该智能体会针对候选程序设计并运行实验。为了衡量实验环节的贡献，我们将AgenticEvolve与No-analysis（一种除禁用实验外完全相同的配置）进行比较。在使用三种大语言模型的两个启发式设计任务中，AgenticEvolve在隐藏和未见过的实例上都生成了比No-analysis和OpenEvolve更好的程序。它以少得多的评估次数和相当的成本达到了基线的最终质量。在十二个方程发现问题（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: AgenticEvolve让持久化的大语言模型智能体在进化程序搜索的评估间隙自主设计并运行实验，从而以更少的评估次数和相当的成本生成显著更优的程序。
en_tdlr: AgenticEvolve uses persistent language model agents that design and run experiments between evaluations in evolutionary program search, yielding better programs with far fewer evaluations and comparable cost.
